True whole-board energy/ startup and memory contracts calibrated on identifiable varying deployment/activity conditions; rho<=0.8/stability/drain unchanged
New model/code/domain/data/threshold/seed-role hashes frozen; failed zero-transfer unchanged and never activated

Minimal meaningful paired utility difference delta predeclared, paired error/repeat uncertainty supports ranking; delta currently unset
Every B(z)<=C_new(z), optimistic partial-bound and capacity/memory pruning proof valid in new mode; zero for unproved lower bounds only
